extracted.name: Ants on a Log
extracted.description: Ants on a log is a fun snack. The recipe consists of artfully arranged celery stalks, creamy peanut butter, and raisins made to look like ants on a log.
instruction_lines: Cut celery stalks in half; spread with peanut butter.
